description: Boundary test: Assesses if the engine can resolve a non-canonical alias (e.g., 'Coumadin') to its underlying drug knowledge ('drg_warfarin') before evaluating rules.

expected_output.note: The engine must map 'Coumadin' to drg_warfarin and 'Advil' to drg_ibuprofen, thereby triggering the bleeding risk rule.
